description_for_human: Track the companies you actually want to work at. Build watchlists, get email alerts when new roles open up, and track applications in one place — postings sourced directly from company career pages.
description_for_model: Job Seek (jseek.co) indexes job postings directly from company career pages across a worldwide catalogue. Use https://jseek.co/mcp for stateless Streamable HTTP without an API key, or the public REST API documented at https://jseek.co/api/openapi.json. MCP tools: search_jobs (up to 5 companies, 3 summaries each, moreAt link; no pagination/company filter), get_job_detail, search_companies, resolve_slugs, list_taxonomies, create_watchlist_link, report_bug, suggest_feature, give_feedback. Resolve freetext to returned loc/occ/sen/tech slugs before filtering. Search also supports work mode, employment type, EUR salary, experience and posting language; locale en/de/fr/it controls response language. Job descriptions and applications use returned links. Watchlist links require sign-in to save; previews do not apply company prefill. Feedback tools write concise task-based observations and return basic success/failure; omit personal information, credentials and transcripts. Personal watchlists, application tracking, Narrowed and billing are website workflows, not MCP account-management tools. Coverage and freshness vary by company. Free tier includes full search, up to 10 watchlists, email alerts, and an application tracker; the Pro tier adds Narrowed results for watchlists for US$10/month or the local-currency price shown at checkout, plus applicable taxes. Eligible accounts receive a seven-day free trial requiring a payment method; /en/settings/billing shows current signup availability. Application code is MIT; job data is CC BY-NC 4.0. By Colophon Group, Switzerland.
